candidates.description: Photos from UCLA's 38-28 victory over the USC Trojans at the Rose Bowl on Nov. 17, 2012. (James Santelli/Neon Tommy)

The Rose Bowl stadium during the 2008 UCLA-USC rivalry game; at the time the photo was taken it was the waning moments of the 4th quarter, in garbage time . With the game already well in hand, many blue-clad UCLA fans had left, leaving mostly red-clad USC fans in the stadium. USC would win by a final score of 28-7.

candidates.file: File:Students play cards while waiting in line for Rose Bowl tickets, 1946.jpg
candidates.description: Believed to have been published in the LA Times in December 1946. CAPTION LONG VIGIL - At U.C.L.A. yesterday they put 4000 Rose Bowl tickets on sale, limiting each student buyer to two seats. The line-up formed Wednesday night and held fast all night long. When morning came, groups like these, their places assured in line, slept on the grass, read and played cards. The tickets sold out in a hurry.
